{{Quote|You can win without fighting, but it's harder to do; the enemy is rarely so cooperative.|Haras Jundop|<ref name="RoE" />}}
'''Haras Jundop''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Jundop served as Ground Marshal of [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].<ref name="RoE" />
